title: Finite-time blow-up for the four-dimensional mass-critical quadratic nonlinear Schrödinger system without mass resonance
summary: We study the focusing quadratic nonlinear Schrödinger system \[ \begin{cases} i\partial_t u+Δu=-2v\overline{u}, \\ i\partial_t v+κΔv=-u^2, \end{cases} \qquad (t,x)\in I\times\mathbb R^4, \] where $κ>0$. In the non-mass-resonant case $κ\neq \frac12$, previous works of Inui--Kishimoto--Nishimura and Dinh--Forcella showed that radial solutions with negative energy must either blow up in finite time or exist globally while their $H^1$-norm grows without bound.
